decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component system extends core spraying competence into corrosion protection, and with no clear shortfall against aspirations, slack lets the firm keep carrying it while results mature.
The low-pressure injection pump is close to the established construction-repair offer, has its own web page and ties up few extra resources, so it likely meets aspirations.
The multi-model transfer pump line builds on core conveying know-how and in-house manufacturing, and there is no performance gap that would trigger problemistic search.
Fire protection flow monitoring fits the digitalization strategy and has its own page, so despite uncertain adoption, slack and strategic fit justify keeping it.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system was launched only in 2024 and sits close to the core offer, so dropping it this early would be premature given no evident shortfall.
